snippet.title: Black Reliquary Early Access Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Black Reliquary is an ambitious overhaul mod for Darkest Dungeon. The project is still in development, but the latest update will be readily available through a Steam Store page download in the coming months! Big thanks to @E5games and @zvr8215 for their help in creating the trailer!

Black Reliquary is a total conversion mod for Darkest Dungeon and will have its own steam download at: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2119270/Black_Reliquary/ 

Abandon what you think you know. The Valley does not know mercy or sympathy, and the trials ahead of you will be unlike anything you have faced before! Find yourself in your new home aboard the Flameseeker airship, and reunite with an old acquaintance from many years past, as you join forces to assault the oppressive and mysterious Black Reliquary.

We at Reliquary Team want to extend our biggest thanks to Red Hook for being so accommodating during this process, and to all of our wonderful fans and supporters who have helped make this project possible! The finish line is still ahead of us, but our march is steady.

If you're interested in seeing our progress, we have a Twitter which we post progress updates on every week or so:
https://twitter.com/ReliquaryMod

If you'd like to support us financially, we do have a Patreon:
https://www.patreon.com/blackreliquary

#blackreliquary #darkestdungeon #modding
